Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1212
Claimant:
Howard Davenport
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
1 Mar 2025
Claim received for a sideswipe that occurred while the insured was changing lanes. The claimant reports a knee
injury and is not represented by an attorney, so I am handling direct contact with the claimant.
4 Mar 2025
Reviewed the first recorded statement. The claimant described the lane change and the contact on the rear
passenger side in the same way as the initial report, and the account is consistent so far.
15 Mar 2025
Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the accident happened as described and place the claimant in
the vehicle at the time. Photos submitted by the other driver show damage that is mostly in line with the described
impact.
27 Mar 2025
Reviewed the vehicle appraisal. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing in the file suggests the
damage predates the start of coverage. The driver is a household member of the policyholder and is covered under
the policy.
28 Mar 2025
Claimant reports a knee injury that is plausible for a collision of this type. No prior injury to the same area is known
from the records I have reviewed so far.
27 May 2025
Medical treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. I have requested the treatment notes and
will confirm progress before setting a reserve.
5 Aug 2025
Claimant repeated the same account in each conversation since the first report. Treatment records are pending, and
the file will be updated once they are received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
